cros_ec: Use a dedicated structure for mkbp state to stay within bounds The cros_ec_scan_keyboard function is expected to fill an array of keyscan cols, provided by the EC as a key matrix. This was done by casting the key_matrix element of the ec_response_get_next_data structure as a cros_ec_keyscan structure, that initially only contained a similar key matrix, making the cast somewhat valid. However, the buttons element was added to that structure, which increased its size. As ec_command is called with the size of that structure and copies that number of bytes to the provided location, the added bytes ended up copying data out of the bounds of the initial key matrix, leading to unpredictible results. On a specific test run with a big, this would change the first byte of the (unrelated) sound_ops variable, causing a prefetch error exception. Passing the key matrix (instead of the whole cros_ec_keyscan structure) from a proper cros_ec_keyscan structure to ec_command (with the right size) resolves the issue. The data is then copied over to the ec_response_get_next_data structure as needed for the rest of the code to work normally. BUG=none BRANCH=none TEST=boot on big: keyboard works and it doesn't hang anymore Change-Id: If77a721c10b179e0e76cfcb706ea972fbf5646b9 Signed-off-by: Paul Kocialkowski <contact@paulk.fr> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/446096 Reviewed-by: Aseda Aboagye <aaboagye@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Shawn N <shawnn@chromium.org>

install_toolchain: do not die if ${toolchain}/go is not installed. Having go installed as part of a toolchain was always optional. install_toolchain_in_provided() function has a check if $go_ver is empty, and only adds go to package.provided if it's not. Unfortunately, cross_get_version() was dying if go is not found. I've split cross_get_version() into two functions. The original cross_get_version() does not die if the package is not found. A new function cross_get_version_or_die() checks the results and dies if the package was not found. Checking go version uses cross_get_version(). Checking gcc/glibc version uses cross_get_version_or_die(). BUG=None TEST='setup_board --board=x86-zgb' works after disabling i686-pc-linux-gnu-go in cl/444042. Change-Id: Ice92e2c8a5a91ff474f2f3a35b8d6b2be0d92a5c Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/444043 Commit-Ready: Rahul Chaudhry <rahulchaudhry@chromium.org> Tested-by: Rahul Chaudhry <rahulchaudhry@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Luis Lozano <llozano@chromium.org>
